title: family_answer
description: Answer a child's request. yes needs preset (one of the category's presets) and is carried out as a release (same checks as family_release; not allowed → family_error release_not_allowed, the request stays open for others and the admin). no may carry a short message. The first answer wins; a later one gets family_error already_answered with the request. Family manager devices (effective rule family_manager) and babysitter devices (kind babysitter, effective rule babysitter_requests, with access right now and over the hub WebSocket = at home); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. A babysitter may only answer no or yes with 15m, 30m or access_end (else preset_not_allowed); its Yes never lasts beyond the end of its access window and never releases a blocked device type, an exception or a fixed rule (release_not_allowed). Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_request (closed); the child gets kids_request_state, the other family managers family_request.
